items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: George Weins’ Kool Jazz Festival, at Carnegie Hall, Lorraine Gordon booking you into the Village Vanguard.

ctx.x: How about in the early 1990’s? It seems the cycle comes around every few years. New popularity. George Weins’ Kool Jazz Festival, at Carnegie Hall, Lorraine Gordon booking you into the Village Vanguard. Tell me about that.
What did I do at the Vanguard?
